about.title: A designer-minded frontend practice.
about.intro: I build portfolio and business websites that feel considered, readable, and easy to maintain after launch.
about.processSectionIntro: A simple working rhythm that keeps pages readable and maintainable.
body: My work sits between design and implementation. I translate layouts, content, and interaction ideas into frontend systems that stay clean when pages grow and revisions pile up.
I care about visual rhythm, content hierarchy, and practical structure. That usually means reusable sections, token-driven styling, and layouts that still feel deliberate on smaller screens.
Most of the projects I enjoy combine interface polish with real delivery work: shipping pages, tightening responsive behavior, organizing content, and making the next update easier instead of harder.
principles: Content should read clearly before decoration starts.
Reusable layout systems beat one-off page fixes.
Mockups matter, but shipped code has to stay editable.
Frontend polish should improve trust, not add noise.

process.title: Structure first
process.description: Map the page flow, content hierarchy, and reusable sections before styling details.

process.title: Design into code
process.description: Translate mockups into token-based components with responsive spacing and readable markup.

process.title: Refine the system
process.description: Clean repetition, tighten edge cases, and leave the page easier to extend after launch.

resume.headline: Frontend Web Developer and Graphic Designer
resume.summary: Frontend web developer and graphic designer focused on responsive implementation, WordPress builds, Figma-to-code work, and maintainable content-driven websites.

highlights: Support Elementor v2 and v3 to v4 migrations by setting up global variables and reusable class structures for more consistent styling and easier maintenance.
Build custom WordPress themes and reusable templates for company websites.
Maintain 8+ company websites and 3+ client websites, including updates, security cleanup, spam prevention, audits, and performance work.
Create branding and marketing assets for internal and client use, and prepare websites for SEO handoff and deployment through cPanel and Hostinger.
Developed and maintained client websites across WordPress and React projects.
Translated Figma designs into responsive React interfaces with accessibility in mind.
Contributed to reusable UI patterns and design-system work that made project builds easier to maintain.
Supported delivery workflows using Git, GitHub Actions, Vitest, and Cloudflare.
Improved large-format print workflows through RIP setup, color calibration, and cutting-process cleanup.
Created reusable templates and organized asset libraries to reduce manual revisions across production work.
Troubleshot hardware and software issues across production workstations and print systems.
Designed social media graphics and branded marketing assets for multiple branches.
Worked with branch managers and marketing teams to refine assets and keep campaign visuals consistent.

projects.title: ABCDE CREATIVE
projects.summary: A portfolio and services website focused on clear service messaging, modular page sections, and a sharper visual rhythm across marketing pages.
projects.challenge: The site needed stronger hierarchy and more reusable structure so new case-study and service pages could be added without layout drift.
approach: Reworked marketing sections into reusable content blocks.
Tightened spacing and type rhythm for clearer scanning.
Aligned page components so future pages could follow the same system.
outcome: Cleaner presentation across portfolio and services content.
More consistent page-building patterns for future updates.

gallery.alt: Mock landing page composition for ABCDE Creative with modular sections and structured content blocks.
gallery.caption: Homepage direction with reusable marketing sections.

gallery.alt: Mock case-study detail screen showing typography hierarchy, stats, and project modules.
gallery.caption: Case-study system built for easier expansion.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.body: The original content felt serviceable but flat. New pages risked turning into one-off layouts, which made the system harder to extend with confidence.

image.alt: Mock layout showing the challenge phase for ABCDE Creative with uneven blocks being reorganized.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I focused on reusable page sections, stronger headings, and a more disciplined layout rhythm so content blocks could carry more of the page without feeling repetitive.

image.alt: Mock layout demonstrating the reusable section system and visual cleanup for ABCDE Creative.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: The result was a cleaner portfolio experience with better section reuse, stronger content hierarchy, and an easier path for future case studies and service pages.

image.alt: Mock layout representing the final polished project presentation for ABCDE Creative.

projects.title: INSIGHT INDEX
projects.summary: A more editorial product showcase for a data-led brand, balancing interface previews with enough context to explain the work.
projects.challenge: The product needed a clearer story. Interface screenshots existed, but the surrounding content was not doing enough to frame why the product mattered.
approach: Introduced content blocks that explained value before details.
Paired interface imagery with concise product context.
Used a cleaner card rhythm for related sections and previews.
outcome: Improved clarity around the product offering.
A better balance of visuals and explanatory copy.
Stronger consistency across overview and feature sections.

gallery.alt: Mock product overview page for Insight Index with cards, charts, and interface previews.
gallery.caption: Product storytelling framed around interface previews.

gallery.alt: Mock feature detail layout for Insight Index showing metrics, annotations, and supporting content.
gallery.caption: Feature detail layout pairing metrics and explanation.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.body: The visual assets were there, but the page still felt like a gallery. It needed context that made the interface feel meaningful instead of decorative.

image.alt: Mock product page illustrating the challenge of unexplained interface visuals.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I paired each visual block with a tighter explanation, leaned on modular cards, and used cleaner spacing so the product story could unfold in a more readable order.

image.alt: Mock product page showing the clearer approach for Insight Index.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: The updated page communicated both interface quality and product value more clearly, giving the work a stronger case-study feel without becoming text-heavy.

image.alt: Mock product page showing the final polished case-study presentation for Insight Index.

projects.title: GSAP ANIMATION
projects.summary: A motion-led frontend experiment focused on scroll choreography, visual pacing, and interaction details that still respected performance.
projects.challenge: The motion needed to feel expressive without overwhelming the content or creating a site that only worked on ideal hardware.
approach: Used animation to support hierarchy instead of replacing it.
Focused on transforms and staged reveals for smoother motion.
Preserved a readable static structure underneath the effects.
outcome: More memorable visual pacing without losing clarity.
Reusable motion patterns for future sections.
A better balance between flair and restraint.

gallery.alt: Mock animation sequence board showing staggered cards and scroll-linked reveals.
gallery.caption: Motion storyboard focused on hierarchy and pacing.

gallery.alt: Mock UI panels showing transitions, overlays, and motion annotation details.
gallery.caption: Interface details designed for expressive but controlled motion.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.body: Motion-heavy work can collapse into spectacle fast. The real challenge was making the animations enhance the story instead of competing with it.

image.alt: Mock storyboard showing the motion challenge for the GSAP Animation project.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I kept the base layout readable, built the motion on transforms, and treated reveal timing as part of content hierarchy instead of as decoration.

image.alt: Mock storyboard showing the motion approach for the GSAP Animation project.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: The final experience felt more polished and memorable, while the static structure still held up for reduced-motion users and smaller screens.

image.alt: Mock storyboard showing the finished motion-led presentation for the GSAP Animation project.

projects.title: TETHERLY
projects.summary: A polished product-marketing concept centered on stronger card systems, clean device mockups, and a calmer visual rhythm.
projects.challenge: The product presentation needed more consistency across cards, sections, and preview imagery so the brand could feel more cohesive.
approach: Standardized the card hierarchy and supporting metadata.
Built a cleaner visual rhythm between sections and imagery.
Used mock product views to make the content more tangible.
outcome: Clearer card patterns and stronger visual consistency.
Better readiness for future landing-page variations.

gallery.alt: Mock product marketing page for Tetherly with cards, feature blocks, and device imagery.
gallery.caption: Card-led product marketing direction.

gallery.alt: Mock feature comparison and CTA layout for Tetherly with tablet and content panels.
gallery.caption: A calmer layout rhythm built around reusable sections.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.body: The experience needed stronger consistency. Cards, metadata, and image treatments were all pulling in slightly different directions.

image.alt: Mock product marketing page showing the initial consistency challenge for Tetherly.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I simplified the section rhythm, tightened the card treatment, and used clearer mockups so the product story felt more unified from top to bottom.

image.alt: Mock product marketing page showing the cleaner section and card approach for Tetherly.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: The resulting concept felt more cohesive, easier to scan, and more reusable as a foundation for future product and landing pages.

image.alt: Mock product marketing page showing the final cohesive presentation for Tetherly.
